key_findings: LXM-15 dose-dependently attenuated mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in SNL rats, an effect blocked by peripheral α7 nicotinic or M4 muscarinic receptor antagonists.
LXM-15 decreased phosphorylated CaMKIIα, CREB, JAK2 and STAT3 and reduced TNF-α and c-fos expression, effects blocked by α7 or M4 antagonists.
